name: @deephub/cloud-protocol
description: DeepHub cloud protocol client: signed transport, zero-knowledge account, X25519 identity, friends, end-to-end encrypted idea delivery. Shared by the DeepHub desktop app and the dsh-deephub-share plugin.
//exports-note: ./limits 是给浏览器侧用的子入口。主入口 index.ts 挂着 node:crypto/node:fs/node:os，从它值导入会被打包器拖进浏览器 bundle 然后炸（vite 会换成空壳 __vite-browser-external，rollup 随即报 generateKeyPairSync is not exported）。limits.ts 自己零依赖。注意 exports 里不能混放非 . 开头的键，Node 会抛 ERR_INVALID_PACKAGE_CONFIG，所以这条说明只能放在外面。
